checks.procedure: For the opt-in calibrated display packet, record selected DisplayDeviceConfig identity and manual brightness sweep in the normal range under controlled lighting; capture measured luminance where a meter is available and check monotonic response. Do not enter HBM.

For the opt-in calibrated packet, record effective automatic-brightness configuration and ALS/brightness response to documented dark-to-bright and bright-to-dark transitions, including settling and hysteresis. Service presence or a setting toggle alone is insufficient.

For the opt-in calibrated packet, inspect minimum/low-brightness rendering for clipping, flicker and unexpected jumps, then record brightness and visibility after suspend/resume. HBM remains excluded pending compatible thermal/timer policy.

On an authorized installed build, record SIM/carrier, registration technology and a successful mobile-data transfer with Wi-Fi disabled. Retain transfer outcome and telephony context without publishing identifiers.
With consenting test peers, send and receive ordinary SMS and record both delivery results and subscription used.

With a consenting test peer, make and receive ordinary non-emergency calls; record connection, two-way audio, route and radio technology during the calls. This does not qualify IMS or emergency service.
Play a known reference clip through each speaker and the earpiece where available; record audibility, channel routing, distortion and volume behavior.
Record and replay known speech through each exposed microphone route; name the app, route and resulting audio file for each measurement.
Use a known USB audio accessory for playback and recording; record routing before connection, while connected and after removal.
Capture sensor enumeration, then measured accelerometer/gyro response and auto-rotate in multiple orientations before and after suspend.
Record proximity near/far transitions and ALS values under documented dark/bright conditions; confirm in-call screen behavior separately from sensor enumeration.
Exercise the exposed system haptic effects and notification vibration; record perceived response, missing effects and unexpected sustained vibration.

Record battery level/charge counter, duration, screen state and wake-source/suspend statistics before and after a controlled unplugged screen-off interval. Compare drain and successful resume under stated network conditions.

Use a certified wired charger/cable; record battery level, current, voltage and temperature over time and successful unplug/replug behavior. Stop on abnormal heat; do not infer maximum negotiated power from a charging icon.
Use a certified compatible Qi charger; record charge progression, current, temperature and removal/replacement behavior. Reverse charging and OEM limits require their own tests.
Record ambient conditions, temperature sensors and thermal status during a bounded ordinary workload and recovery. Stop on abnormal heat; preserve all thermal protections.

In an open-sky location, record the actual cold/warm start conditions, time to fix, reported accuracy and a short track including suspend/resume. Keep coordinates private; service registration is insufficient.

Read an owned NFC tag and, only if desired and authorized, write/read back a disposable owned tag. Record payload agreement and reconnect behavior; tag success does not qualify payments or secure-element applications.
On owned/authorized access points, record association, a real data transfer, reconnect and suspend/resume for each tested band. Name the bands and security mode without publishing credentials.
With an owned accessory, record pairing, media playback, microphone/call routing, reconnect and suspend/resume; identify tested profiles and accessory model.

Save logical-to-physical camera metadata, then verify which front/rear/lens controls Aperture actually exposes. Confirm preview changes against the physical lens; do not invent IDs for the front sensor under logical camera 0.
Save rear still and video outputs, resolution/codec metadata, focus response and stabilization/lens-transition observations. Review the output files for image and audio defects.

Attempt real front selection and save front still/video outputs and metadata. Record an unavailable front selector as a measured failure when actually attempted; admission/startup alone cannot pass this check.

Record Xiaomi Camera version, package grants, startup and preview behavior with bounded linker/crash/AVC logs. Resolve the first actual JNI/service failure while preserving stock tuning and signer boundaries.
Save Xiaomi Camera rear/front still and video output files, metadata and physical-lens transition observations. Record each route explicitly; startup does not prove capture.

Record each tested OEM mode independently in the observation: HDR/LOFIC, Leica, RAW, high-resolution and stabilization. Retain output files/metadata; mark this aggregate pass only when every listed mode is verified, otherwise leave not-run or record an attempted failure.

Compare saved mountinfo, effective /mnt/vendor/mi_ext paths and bounded init logs against vendor fstab and generated first-stage fstab. Vendor may attempt conditional overlays even though generated first-stage entries exclude them; record the actual trigger and result, not an inferred unconditional startup failure.

For each property or Telecom/TeleService/STK resource tied to an observed feature issue, record the exact key/resource, effective value, overlay/idmap state and expected selected value. An image or APK path alone does not prove application; do not import all HyperOS init/property behavior.

During a relevant connectivity/power failure, capture CneApp/TxPwrAdmin effective permission grants and bounded SecurityException/AVC/service logs. Record the exercised operation and observed outcome before selecting a narrow permission or packaging change.

For a feature that actually needs an optional/lazy service, record its known client trigger, registration before/after, init/linker/AVC result and feature behavior. Absence from a single snapshot is not proof of a missing provider; a pass covers only the named exercised services.

excluded_claims: HBM until compatible thermal/timer policy is selected
reverse charging and OEM charge limits
